title: Knowing Our Numbers
description: Class 6 IMO — Knowing Our Numbers: large numbers up to 10 crore, place value in the Indian and International systems, comparison, estimation and Roman numerals up to 1000.

topics.title: Large Numbers, Place Value & Number Systems
topics.concept:
In the Indian system the places are Ones, Tens, Hundreds, Thousands, Ten Thousands, Lakhs, Ten Lakhs and Crores. In the International system they are Ones, Tens, Hundreds, Thousands, Ten Thousands, Hundred Thousands and Millions.

The two systems link up: 10 lakh = 1 million and 1 crore = 10 million. The place value of a digit is the digit times the value of its place.

examples.problem: What is the place value of 7 in 7,53,42,108?
examples.solution: 7 is in the Crores place, so its value is 7,00,00,000.

recap: Indian: …Lakhs, Ten Lakhs, Crores; International: …Hundred Thousands, Millions.

quiz.q: What is the place value of 5 in 4,56,789?
quiz.explanation: 5 is in the Ten Thousands place, so its value is 50,000.

topics.title: Comparison, Ordering & Estimation
topics.concept:
To compare numbers, the one with more digits is larger; if the digit counts match, compare from the left. Estimation uses rounding to the nearest ten, hundred or thousand to get a quick answer.

To round, look at the digit just after the rounding place: 5 or more rounds up, otherwise round down.

examples.solution: The hundreds digit 8 is 5 or more, so it rounds up to 7,000.

recap: More digits means a larger number; otherwise compare from the left.
Round up if the next digit is 5 or more, else round down.

quiz.explanation: The tens digit 6 is 5 or more, so it rounds up to 3,500.

topics.title: Roman Numerals (up to 1000)
topics.concept:
Roman numerals use I = 1, V = 5, X = 10, L = 50, C = 100, D = 500, M = 1000. A letter repeats up to three times to add (XXX = 30).

A smaller letter before a larger one means subtract: IV = 4, IX = 9, XL = 40, XC = 90, CD = 400, CM = 900.
recap: I, V, X, L, C, D, M; repeat up to three times to add.
Smaller before larger means subtract (CD = 400, CM = 900).

questions.explanation: The hundreds digit 8 is 5 or more, so it rounds up to 8,000.

questions.q: What is the place value of 8 in 8,34,56,789?
questions.explanation: 8 is in the Crores place, so its value is 8,00,00,000.
